notes.title: 🦋Save the Villainess is in Steam's GDOC Festival with Bonus Talk!
notes.content:
[p]Come join [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578180/Save_the_Villainess_An_Otome_Isekai_Roleplaying_Game/"]Save the Villainess[/url] in celebrating Steam's [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38233967/"]Game Developers of Color Festival[/url], which celebrates the works of dozens of game developers from diverse backgrounds![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e7f16a459143eb48738086553e825b8f50ff1970.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]Last year, we also had the pleasure of hosting a talk on Save the Villainess at the Game Devs of Color expo. Our talk is called “Why Save the Villainess? Challenging Injustice through Perspective” and can be viewed on Youtube below: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/PqUDQUkWlzM?si=rLecnhgllPyb_Xsf"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] This talk strikes at the heart of an important question that haunts every story of a villainess that experiences and fights against a cruel fate. Namely, what makes a woman a villainess? After all, while Save the Villainess is a game that asks you to discover who wants to murder a villainess, it also reflects on how Jane’s identity as an autistic biracial woman makes her a villainess within the cruel and unjust historical society she is thrown into. Is Jane a villainess because of the past actions of the original Jane Neville? Or is Jane a villainess because she does not follow the rules of her cruel, sexist, and classist culture? 
[/p][p]Finally, how do the injustices that Jane faces as a woman outside the bounds of ‘accepted society’ reflect in the cruelties that people outside the bounds of ‘accepted society’ experience today? [/p][p][/p][p]Ultimately, we hope that everyone who has ever experienced cruelty, persecution, and injustice due to being different from those around her can empathize with Jane and other villainesses like her. If you’ve ever been hurt by others for your differences, we hope Jane is someone you can relate to.[/p]

notes.title: 🦋Save the Villainess Celebrates Edmund's Birthday - Go Ahead, Cake His Day!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Villains and Villainesses,[/p][p]Have you enjoyed your summer, even as the last few days slip away? This is Tanya and Emily, the two devs behind Save the Villainess, and we’re missing our fun in the sun already. Still, we got a lot done this August and we’re eager to share our progress with you. We also want to share  a glimpse of a new map of House, a celebration of Edmund’s birthday, and the release of a free prequel novel![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/51e4dde22a0f8c7562ce0b1093a41dccea38cc52.png"][/img][/p][p]First, we wanted to share this map of House’s eccentric layout that was created by the amazing [url="https://www.salehachowdhury.com/"]Saleha Chowdhury[/url], who created almost all of our item art, animal/creature art, and many backgrounds.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b5cc7b17cc5ebc0cf6e96b56af1ab1e1684c9e7f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Saleha designed this map using dozens of different layers. We programmed her layers within the Ren’py game engine to create a clickable and ever-changing map. This map will change depending on the choices you make within Save the Villainess. There might even be a map-based mini-game depending on how you choose to build your story. Have fun experimenting with your choice of destination. You never know what secrets you’ll uncover by taking the wrong path on the road…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/3ad701bdc81b30baef1791b1d45244c7152e723b.png"][/img][/p][p]This month, for scene 24, we programmed both the first map mini-game and a skippable map tutorial that offers some sassy dialogue from Voice that is based on the choices you make. We also programmed scenes 22 and 23. Scene 22 offers some interesting character development and challenges for Jane. Meanwhile, Scene 23 features Jane meeting a fan-favorite character who loves to give cryptic hints about the plot![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/efc9501a66f6f4ebcc1b007686e65532221f18e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We also significantly revised scenes 25 and 26 for coding next month. These long and detailed scenes tell you more about Carcosa, the fantasy kingdom that this story takes place in. Carcosa is a beautiful and bizarre land full of royals and nobles who justify their immense privilege due to the powerful magic they wield. Are these royals and nobles Jane’s allies, her enemies, or something else entirely? You’ll find out more as you explore these pivotal scenes, read important documents, and make deductions that could save Jane’s life… or doom her forever. [/p][p][/p][p]To learn more about the people and magic of Carcosa even before the game arrives, you can also read our free prequel novel – ‘[url="https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/87587/the-villainess-wants-her-prince-to-live"]The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live![/url]’ We’ll discuss more about the novel below![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png"][/img][/p][p]This August 20th, we celebrated Crown Prince Edmund Alpin's birthday! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/21eeb3e8f3269f783a6964708af92299afb19aee.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]Edmund's birthday fan-art was commissioned from LuckL![/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]As was deduced by clever fans on our discord sever, we chose this date to[url="https://www.yourtango.com/2025389269/zodiac-signs-tarot-horoscope-august-20-2025"] reflect both the Leo star sign as well as the tarot card of the reversed Knight of Cups[/url]... though there might be other interesting aspects to August 20th if you look further. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Together, the Leo star sign and reversed Knight of Cups tarot card reflect Edmund's warmth, optimism, passion, potential to be a leader... but also the clash between idealism and pragmatism that he goes through as he prepares himself to rule the land of Carcosa. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Will Edmund be the fair and just ruler that he wishes to be by the end of his story? [/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Decide for yourself when you play his route. After all, it's [i]your [/i]story too... isn't it?[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]On a more light-hearted note, we also created this[url="https://youtube.com/shorts/0BIX7Z2AsCo?feature=share"] video[/url] to show how Edmund and friends "celebrate" his birthday. Maybe one day, he might even get a good present...[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, as a gift for the end of our summer, we wanted to share the complete version of Save the Villainess’ official prequel novel, “The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live!”[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ce087609795421081372b42ba2b2a0948c9fa79f.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Cover art by Kmochi; Cover design by Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This prequel novel follows Lady Regina Sheridan, a noblewoman in Carcosa who can see into the future. Unfortunately, the future says that she will be executed as a villainess unless she can keep her new fiancé, Prince Artem Alpin, alive.[/p][p][/p][p]The future also tells her someone is hunting Artem… and that he has the survival instincts of a goldfish.[/p][p][/p][p]Please universe, The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live![/p][p][/p][p][b]You can read our prequel novel online at [url="https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/87587/the-villainess-wants-her-prince-to-live"]Royal Road[/url].[/b] [b]You can also download the pdf and the epub version at this [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XWd8uaNilvLFgseAyeAfnO_t38vKtvqK"]Google Drive link[/url].[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Note:[/i][/b] You do not need to play the game to understand the prequel novel or read the prequel  novel to understand the game. However, the mysteries and events of the novel do affect the game, which takes place decades later in the same fantasy kingdom of Carcosa. So if you read the novel, you’ll learn more information ahead of time about the great families of Carcosa, including the Sheridans, Alpins, Nevilles, Burens, and Kuzeys. [/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Warnings[/i][/b]: Please note that this story contains non-graphic depictions of violence, murder, assassination attempts, death threats, and an adorable Alpin prince who has the survivability of a goldfish. Mix in all of the above with one determined villainess lost in a world with terrifying politics and even more terrible families, many orphans, and even more ducks. Stir all of these ingredients vigorously to generate a romantic dark comedy murder mystery action adventure story where changing the future requires cleverness and the ability to frolic. Happy reading![/p][p][/p][p]In any case, thank you for ending your summer with us. We truly appreciate your support and would love to have you keep in touch with us through the links below. Have a great end to your summer and a wonderful start to the autumn that lies ahead! [/p][p][/p][p]Finally, please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:  [/p][list][*][p] [url="https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH"]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!

[/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@BestLaidPlansProductions"]Youtube[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/bestlaidplans.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tumblr.com/bestlaidplansproductions"]Tumblr[/url] - our main social media accounts
[/p][/*][/list][p]With Much Love, [/p][p]Tanya & Emily [/p][p]Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.[/p]

notes.title: 🦋Summer Fun, Faces, and Freedom with Save the Villainess!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Villains and Villainesses,[/p][p]Have you been staying cool in the face of the scorching summer sun? This is Tanya and Emily, the duo behind Save the Villainess, and we’ve been keeping our fans on full blast in our faces. While doing so, we accomplished a lot of fun goals and are ready to share them with you, along with a revealing interview with our character artists at Somate Studio![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/3ad701bdc81b30baef1791b1d45244c7152e723b.png"][/img][/p][p]Let's begin with a first glimpse of [b]Ashe Firalis[/b], a character in one of the beautiful portraits that will show up in our game. Her animated portrait will show up in House during the storyline and will play a critical role by the end of the tale. Thank you to [b]OmegaScales[/b] for commissioning this portrait through Kickstarter and supporting our game! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e143871ff408257d7918c8084abc3d4e1e157c8d.png"][/img][/p][p]This portrait was created by Somate Studio, who created all of our beautiful character designs and sprites. Later in this update, you can read an interview we did with the Project Manager of Somate Studio where she walks us through her design decisions regarding our game. She’ll even share some fun tips for beginner artists! [/p][p][/p][p]This month, we completed a large slate of programming! First, we programmed the closing sequences for chapter 2 and the opening sequences for chapter 3. Each chapter sequence takes about 5 to 10 hours to complete and tells a different “story” using symbology taken from tarot. Tarot plays a key role in our game because it became an increasingly popular form of divination in the late Victorian and early Edwardian time periods that inspired our game. [/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 1’s tarot symbology is the Wheel, while Chapter’s 2 tarot symbology is the Tower. Can you guess what Chapter 3’s tarot symbology is, based on the preview below?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/f400146d3008d36182111ecd2815411fcbfdce86.png"][/img][/p][p]To go with our art, our chapter also includes a thematically fitting quote about inner struggle and acceptance by [b]Carl Jung[/b]. Carl Jung was an influential psychologist who wrote about the importance of coming to terms with one’s lifelong struggle to understand and accept oneself. Since this is one of the cornerstones of our game, we’ve included many of his quotes in it! [/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we programmed scene 21, an animation-heavy scene that can be broken down into 4 interwoven sequences which build upon each other to tell a haunting story that you must analyze for clues regarding the original Jane Neville. After all, how can you avoid the tragic fate of the original villainess if you do not understand what happened to her in the first place? [/p][p][/p][p]We also revised and edited our existing writing for scenes 22, 23, and 24 to prepare them for programming next month. These scenes all contain important clues to the mystery that build upon past scenes. One of these scenes also includes an optional tutorial for a new gameplay mechanic we wrote about last month. This tutorial contains all new banter by fan-favorite character, Voice. Voice may even have some interesting things to say if you keep saying taht you don’t understand their instructions…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png"][/img][/p][p]Let’s conclude with an interview we conducted with the Project Manager of Somate Studio. Somate Studio is the art team we partnered with to create all the character designs from Save the Villainess. They have also worked on the character art and design for games such as Peachleaf Valley and Volantes. We are thrilled to share more about their work with you – with additional love to the wonderful people on our [url="https://discord.gg/w5tQZUFwAH"]game’s discord server[/url] who supplied these questions! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Question 1: What's your favorite character or outfit in this game?[/b][/p][p][i][b]Somate Studio[/b][/i][b]: [/b]There are many things I enjoyed about working on this project. But the first thing that impressed me was the main character, because she's a villain type. At that time, this trope was super popular, and I thought it was really cool to create such a character. I really like Jane's facial proportions; I'm drawn to unique facial proportions, like Anya Taylor-Joy's. While not entirely based on her, as we still closely followed the story's description, she was part of the inspiration for Jane's face.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/add1cd81de5676afa441169d9335a9d1aa5976d5.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Question 2: Who was the hardest Love Interest or Character for your team to draw/create and why?[/b][/p][p][i][b]Somate Studio[/b][/i][b]: [/b]The most challenging character to create, in my opinion, was Edmund. We wanted to convey a clean, profound face—a sharp yet friendly and unpredictable look that most important royal characters embody. We paid a lot of attention to his facial expressions, neat hairstyle, and standing posture. His clothes were also intentionally made to look more modern, rather than close to military uniforms or tailcoats \[editor: from the Victorian period], because I wanted to portray him as a rational future monarch who wouldn't be conservative with old ways. That's what I think, but I'm not sure if that's been conveyed. Overall, though, we're satisfied with the result.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/0674396ba4bd18dd1d07a578ff65c263049083d2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Question 3: Who was the easiest Love Interest or Character for your team to draw/create and why?[/b][/p][p][i][b]Somate Studio[/b][/i][b]: [/b]The easiest character to create was Izel. He's always been our forte: a cool, handsome, very Northern-type character.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/f2f7cdd3707647246e2c8f567225b0192e6baf05.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Question 4: Who are your favorite villainesses?[/b][/p][p][i][b]Somate Studio[/b][/i][b]: [/b]I like the femme fatale character archetype, so my favorite villainess recently is Makima from the [i]Chainsaw Man[/i] series. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Question 5: Are there any art details you are especially proud of in Save the Villainess that you want to point to?[/b][/p][p][i][b]Somate Studio[/b][/i][b]: [/b]What I'm most proud of, I think, is that we paid a lot of attention to making the characters' clothing as authentic as possible when compared to the Edwardian era which served as inspiration. Of course, this is still a story with fantasy elements, so it still needs costume details to reflect that. And naturally, balancing the aesthetic of the era with the old-fashioned atmosphere was also a consideration. I'm also proud that all the costumes look like they could actually be sewn into real clothes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Question 6: Do you have any tips for beginners who are starting to learn how to draw art?[/b][/p][p][i][b]Somate Studio[/b][/i][b]:[/b] I think most advice emphasizes that people should start with the basics, and I completely agree with that. Even if you're a professional, honing your fundamentals is something that always needs to happen, because habits can easily lead to basic mistakes. However, this is easy when you're already familiar with it and know where you're going wrong and what you need to do to fix it. But for a beginner, it's clearly not easy at all.[/p][p]When you don't know where to start, studying art from masters is a good beginning. When you learn this way, your brain constantly asks, "How did they do that?" When you find the answer, you'll feel satisfied and confident to move forward. And even if you haven't found the answer, you'll still be looking for it. It's during these times that your interests and abilities will become clearer, and the path forward will emerge. At that point, deciding who to learn from, what to learn, and which tools to use will ultimately determine the kind of artist you want to become. And importantly, maintain stable mental health! This profession often struggles with psychological issues. I consider it part of... occupational hazard, lol.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Question 7: What kind of software or tablet do you use to draw?[/b][/p][p][i][b]Somate Studio:[/b][/i] We usually use Clip Studio Paint. I'm not used to drawing directly on a screen, so I still use screenless tablets, like before.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again to Somate Studio for working on Save the Villainess and for the wonderful interview. We look forward to sharing new character designs from them in the future as our game continues to develop![/p][p][/p][p] Finally, we wanted to finish with a recommendation for a new game by our friends at DEADline Studios.  They recently published PIG: The Game, a short and deliciously dark horror horror game where you must pay or perish. In this game, you'll challenge the mysterious Alleyman to a deadly dice game. Will you win more time with your roles... or lose what little time you have? [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/8b2f455a98d0e8ced8a0f3eb6efd730ae25193a1.png"][/img][/p][p]You can play [url="https://deadline-co.itch.io/pig"]PIG: The Game for free on Itch.io[/url]. If you enjoy this dark little treat, please consider checking out their other horror games, including [url="https://deadline-co.itch.io/fools-paradise"]Fool's Paradise[/url]. If you love beautiful, bone-chilling horror games, all their works are fantastic! [/p][p][/p][p]Finally, please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:  [/p][list][*][p] [url="https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH"]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!
[/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://subscribepage.io/029GuV"]Our mailing list[/url] - we send free cards featuring new banter from our main characters every month. This June, everyone will discuss what kind of flower represents their love in this season of Pride.
[/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@BestLaidPlansProductions"]Youtube[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/bestlaidplans.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tumblr.com/bestlaidplansproductions"]Tumblr[/url] - our main social media accounts
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for joining us for another lovely month and update, friends. We’ll see you in June with more fun updates on our game! 

With Much Love,
Tanya & Emily [/p][p]Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.[/p]

notes.title: 🦋Pride and Posies: Staging Save the Villainess this Summer!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/946014a10d7e89fad6ba789e52211bc348ac135a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear Villains and Villainesses,[/p][p][/p][p]This is Tanya and Emily, the co-developers behind Save the Villainess. We hope you’re having a great time during this first month of summer and not allowing the sun’s rays to scorch your delicate villain or villainess skin. Even as you continue your summer frolics, we have some fun updates and surprises!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/3ad701bdc81b30baef1791b1d45244c7152e723b.png"][/img][/p][p]This June, we programmed scenes 19 and 20 which are pivotal scenes that you will receive based on the choices you made in the previous scenes. Scene 19 is a multi-sequence scene that plays out as a three-part tragedy. It is one of our more elaborate bad endings and features new animations, lengthy dialogue, and a tragic final twist. The more you’re willing to explore difficult consequences, the more you’ll learn! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/9d3e41f45a8a8697c7b7e8fee71d0d3302598fa5.png"][/img][i][b]Ben has always wished for Jane’s courage… but is the cost of it too much to bear?[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 20 is the alternate scene that you will receive if you make different choices throughout the last few deduction sequences. You’ll get to see a different side of Jane - one that has [i][b]had it [/b][/i]with constant threats and is willing to strike back! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/56f314a40538062863cd716cf8dff20b5ae30c9e.png"][/img][i][b]Pictured: One villainess who is DONE with the men trying to destroy her.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]We also ran some experimental writing and coding tests and discovered that we can incorporate two new gameplay elements into our future scenes. These gameplay elements have now been added to our existing script outline and will offer exciting deductive challenges for those who wish to challenge themselves by playing in the harder detective mode. Otherwise, you can always use the in-game story mode and/or our free walkthrough guide to solve all of the puzzles/deductions.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/501f998b333d45ff543c052690336e64e48ad2ef.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to Emily’s History Corner, a new segment that we ran in previous streams but are now bringing to our updates! This segment allows us to share some of the fun historical details that have shaped our story, our visuals, and our characters. For June, Emily will share more on our use of floriography (the technical name for the language of flowers) in Save The Villainess. [/p][p][/p][p]Save the Villainess is a historical fantasy game that takes place in Carcosa, a magical kingdom that is patterned after England in the late Victorian and Early Edwardian time periods. We incorporated the Victorian interest in floriography, which allowed people to give different meanings to plants and flowers and use them to demonstrate affection, friendship or even threats. We use flowers and plants in Save the Villainess to communicate subtle meanings about our characters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b74f6748a6611244502f574b3778bbaa83264d4c.png"][/img][i][b]Can you figure out the meanings behind the flowers on Izel’s list?[/b][/i][/p][p]
Victorians sometimes created small bouquets ( called “tussie-mussies”) to wear as corsages or to give to their lovers. Depending on where a woman pinned a tussie-mussie, she could communicate whether she was interested in the suitor who sent her the bouquet… or whether he should leave in disgrace. Can you decode the symbolic tussie-mussies we wove into Jane’s costumes? [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/add1cd81de5676afa441169d9335a9d1aa5976d5.png"][/img][i][b]Thanks again to Somate Studio for weaving symbolism into our characters’ designs![/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]As a tribute to the Victorians and as lovers of plants [i]and[/i] symbolism, we’ve incorporated Victorian and contemporary use of plant and flower language in our game. We’ll write more about that process in our upcoming art book. In the meantime, keep your eyes peeled for the floral messages of love and destruction lurking within Save the Villainess.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/9780b723c329321c2bc9cfd50f6a0da4e9aa5443.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ll never know when symbolic plants will appear on the stage![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4fc6fd8cf12ede93426c4ce8296ff8af5c363b40.png"][/img]We wanted to finish by wishing you a Happy Pride Month! As women writing a story centered on a pansexual protagonist who can fall in love with a wide range of love interests, this month means a great deal to us. We wanted to share our joy through our beloved nonbinary suspect and love interest, Servant.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/a53fd28f6cfb9b6a2c3ff3442227a43f6d61dabb.png"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, even someone who is a little… [i]uncertain [/i]about normal human emotions can see the beauty of this holiday. So Happy Pride, friends. May you continue to love with all your heart!  [/p][p][/p][p]Finally, please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:  [/p][list][*][p] [url="https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH"]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!
[/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://subscribepage.io/029GuV"]Our mailing list[/url] - we send free cards featuring new banter from our main characters every month. This June, everyone will discuss what kind of flower represents their love in this season of Pride.

notes.title: Spring Has Sprung for Updates & Izel's Birthday!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/62aef9cb3b48dbb8af860621702d4f3673fa7278.png[/img]

Dear Villains and Villainesses,

This is Tanya and Emily, the developers behind Save the Villainess. We’re here to end the month of May with an update on the development of our game. We’re also celebrating the birthday of our exquisite (if rather poor) Duke of the North, Izel Kuzey. Come bask in his tales of life in the cozy, charming, only slightly deadly North!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/3ad701bdc81b30baef1791b1d45244c7152e723b.png[/img]

This month, we completed programming the very complex scene 18, which is a multi-part puzzle that draws upon information revealed to you in scenes 16 and 17. If you love the idea of interrogating three gorgeous suspects to make logical deductions about their secrets, this puzzle will delight you! If you’re not, you can always turn on story mode or use our free game walkthrough to complete this program and enjoy the dramatic end to the scene. We hope to keep you as invested in Jane’s survival as Jane herself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/f3fe85a97905c73ab1309ca33900c2f02b5204db.png[/img]
[i]Plus you get some great safety tips from Izel. Remember not to mix fire with phosphor![/i]

We also wrote scene 20 (which gives a pay-off to your decisions in scene 18) and revised the existing outline for the upcoming interconnected scenes 21 to 25. These scenes contain a great deal of important world-building and context for the strange, fantastical kingdom of Carcosa. We revised these scenes to deepen your understanding of Carcosa and the powerful, ruthless noble families who lead it. After all, the more you know about the dangers of the people and creatures around you, the more capable you are of saving your villainess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4fc6fd8cf12ede93426c4ce8296ff8af5c363b40.png[/img]

This month, we’re celebrating the birthday of Izel Kuzey, our beloved Duke of the North. Enjoy a video of him speaking about his birthday below!

[previewyoutube=3oqcFepzCJg;full][/previewyoutube]
Izel is our subversion of the classic Duke of the North character. When you think of that character, you typically think of a cold, hard man who has three words and two facial expressions a week. Yet while Izel is not the most emotionally expressive person and (like any good Duke of the North) has his fair share of family tragedies in a harsh, monster-infested land, we wanted to make Izel a far more entertaining and unusual character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/bc8dc4dc40f82445ce560e6aaa7dbb36adc13654.png[/img]
[i]Between the feet fish and the werebear assassins, it's a wonder that Izel didn't die years ago.[/i]

Izel is as neurodivergent as Jane is… and like her, his skills shouldn’t be underestimated. After all, you can only survive a land as horrifying as the North if you think in ways that no one else can anticipate. If you pay attention to Izel’s words, there are very interesting things to discover about him. So keep listening to what Izel has to say… and what he doesn’t say.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b611b9edb0fa6fcf2ee71aa0fe1711cb0d472d13.png[/img]
[i]Izel also might have an unexpected amount of romance in his soul![/i]

Are you ready to go on your tour of the scenic North? Just remember to get some gold to tip your friendly Kuzey hosts and avoid eye-contact with the feet fish…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/acf03518b7c0ced83c038561e0a61f433b9d43fe.png[/img]

We were also featured in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737-Indie-Assemble/sale/indieassemble]Indie Assemble event on Steam[/url], hosted by [url=https://excaliber.it/en/?snr=1_1056_615_indieassemble_1601]Excaliber[/url]. Indie Assemble features over 1,000 indie games from over 600 studios across the world. Thanks again to Giorgio Catania for organizing this great event for small indie developers like us!

Finally, please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!
[*] [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Our mailing list[/url] - we send free cards featuring new banter from our main characters every month. This May, Jane, Edmund, Izel, Ben, and Servant wish Izel a happy birthday - with the best/worst pun we've had so far! 
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@BestLaidPlansProductions]Youtube[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/bestlaidplans.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], and [url=https://www.tumblr.com/bestlaidplansproductions]Tumblr[/url] - our main social media accounts
[/list]
Thanks again for joining us for another lovely month and update, friends. We’ll see you in June with more fun updates on our game! 

With Much Love,
Tanya & Emily
Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.

notes.title: Celebrating Jane's Birthday, Dating a Dream Lover, and April Successes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/0d9aa021a9a1093e9e47fa86f13aef3fc3dbd894.png[/img]

Dear Villains and Villainesses, 

This is Tanya and Emily, the developers of Save the Villainess. We have a lot of fun game updates to show you this April. We're celebrating Jane's birthday, showcasing the end of the Dream Lovers tournament, and have footage of a special ‘date’ with the tournament winner. Stay tuned for more mayhem and madness!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/3ad701bdc81b30baef1791b1d45244c7152e723b.png[/img]

This month was a great month for those who love to delve deep into intricate plots with plenty of suspense, character interactions, and mysteries! Our writing and programming focused on our game’s mysteries, with us first revising, editing, and then programming Scene 16. 

Scene 16 is a complex and fun multi-part puzzle that will lead to an upcoming in-game climax. For this scene, we edited and reworked items from our existing bedroom background so that they could be used as part of a point and click puzzle. 

As is a key goal of our game, both the correct and incorrect choices in the scene offer something interesting for your play of the game. If you make the incorrect choice, you’re one step closer to a bad ending but might discover some easter eggs and clues to the larger mystery. If you make the correct choices, you’ll be rewarded with very special scenes featuring characters you already know…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/85f9ca65e936a54cb341f56346f90e268cba5214.png[/img]

We also completed the writing and programming for Scene 17, which features Jane and a special guest while providing hints of dark secrets and surprises.

Additionally, we worked on writing and editing Scenes 18, 19, and 20. All these scenes needed to be co-edited together because the mystery deduction choices that appear in Scenes 16 and 17 are linked to the outcomes you experience and the deductions you can complete in Scenes 18, 19, and 20.  Ultimately, we set up a complex set of interwoven conditional deductions that will allow you to learn much more about the relationships the villains had with her possible former fiancés. This newfound knowledge may be touching or troubling, depending on how you interpret it…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4fc6fd8cf12ede93426c4ce8296ff8af5c363b40.png[/img]

This April 6th, we celebrated our villainess Jane’s birthday! Jane is our loving tribute to all of the many neurodivergent women we have known and loved. She’s a little bit of Katarina Claes from My Next Life as a Villainess, a little bit of Princess Mia from Tearmoon Empire, a lot of our own experiences as neurodivergent women on the autism spectrum… and her own weird, complicated, brilliant, and very subtle self. 

Ultimately, Jane is a person who is trapped in a terrible situation who can still finder her way to freedom and justice with your help. We hope you can see a reflection of yourself in her desire to survive no matter what horrors the world tosses at her. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ec04cce8faceeed6a08b3b13a178beb9b77c1b10.png[/img]

As you can see, Jane is determined to love herself on her birthday despite the forces against her. You can [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]join our mailing list and email us for this month's character cards[/url] to learn what Edmund, Izel, Ben, and Servant would say to Jane on her birthday!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png[/img]

This month, we had the pleasure of seeing different people play through Save the Villainess’ demo in great detail.

First, [url=https://bsky.app/profile/chirkrasia.bsky.social]Chirkrasia[/url] played through our entire demo. She brought her beautiful voice and a brilliant artist’s eye to the game and discovered some recurring motifs and details we hid into our backgrounds and character designs. Tanya also spent about an hour chatting with Chirkrasia and other viewers in each stream. You can see more of her Save the Villainess streams on her [url=https://www.twitch.tv/chirkrasia_g/videos]twitch videos page[/url]. 

Second, Amyseekmeout is creating a detailed playthrough of our demo under the [Save the Villainess → #stv-playthroughs-threads → Amy’s Demo Playthrough] section on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH]discord server[/url]. She and other brilliant players have discovered several hidden secrets, including food choices that shout out to Marie Antoinette (one of our major inspirations), hidden themes of revolution, and the importance of bear traps. To help her discover more secrets, please check her playthrough thread on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH]discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ffc5042004727386ee1d81aec3092400080149d3.jpg[/img]

This April, we completed our dream lover contest with a final round between our two most popular love interests – Izel Kuzey, Duke of the North, and Servant, the mysterious maid/butler of the House. They had a fierce battle but in the end, Servant won the vote for the Dream Lover among our non-villainess cast.

Izel had an interesting response to his defeat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/62b4625425a2ad258135c7fa0dc0c24986799767.png[/img]

Won’t you please donate a few gold coins to a Kuzey grandmother and save a three-headed raccoon today? 

Meanwhile, Servant was initially puzzled by your desire for them… until they decided they understood just what you meant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/beab9160fb6c9bee84ebcd57a0e48a3f3e819053.png[/img]

Even better is that Servant’s reward for winning the title of Dream Lover was a ‘date’ with Jane. So what happens when a slightly terrifying maid meets with a survival-minded villainess? 

[previewyoutube=ODfTv39PMxk;full][/previewyoutube]

All hail the two best lovers in the land! 

Finally, please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!
[*] [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Our mailing list[/url] - we send free cards featuring new banter from our main characters every month. This March, Jane, Edmund, Izel, Ben, and Servant talk to you about their favorite reading materials in honor of National Reading Month!

[/list]

notes.title: March Madness Meets Save the Villainess!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ffc5042004727386ee1d81aec3092400080149d3.jpg[/img]

Dear Villains and Villainesses, 

This is Tanya and Emily, the developers of Save the Villainess. We are excited to bring you the first official update of the spring. We had a lot of fun preparing writing and programming updates, as well as letting you know about a Dream Lover tournament where you get to cast the final deciding vote on who is the dreamiest love interest in our game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/271e2df0163ddc6b47644fef43f5e3bc0b18303a.png[/img]

One of our major goals in our game is to allow players to spend quality time with characters even as we introduce more complexities and complications into our murder-mystery plot. Understanding the characters brings you ever closer to unraveling the mysteries of the game - who wants to kill the villainess and how can she be saved?

This month, we balanced character interactions with the mystery elements of our story as we worked on scenes from our Common Route (CR). Specifically, we wrote and edited scenes CR 14 and 15. These scenes give Jane the chance to receive vital information that will assist with a major point-and-click mystery sequence in scene CR 16.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/cc7a57e03c78c4c8a437e17d1b893172d31bb043.png[/img]

[i]Note: If you consider the dangers of wainscoting, cushions, and asking for food other than apples, perhaps postcards too conceal sinister secrets. Why do you think that Servant hates them so?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5e288e126631ba639758e100cab2b24a2055dc4f.png[/img]

In Save the Villainess, you are in charge of keeping your villainess safe from harm. Thus, you must investigate every possible object that may cause her harm… including the rooms of the murderous and possibly sentient apple-loving House where she is stranded.

Our point-and-click and mystery deductions are inspired by games like Unavowed, Grim Fandango, Sweet Fuse, Contradiction: Spot the Liar, and Even if Tempest. Just like these mystery games, we put our protagonist’s fate in your hands. Her survival depends on your cunning and detective skills.

We are currently developing the major point-and-click deduction puzzle of scene CR 16. Our goal is to create a puzzle that is more complex than the “beginner” puzzle in the  the demo. Fans of mystery games will find this a fun challenge! However, if you would ever like more help with the mysteries, you can always turn on Story Mode or use the free walkthrough we will release when the game is out. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/632b9beb07c19e9fdf86faa026336bf9852687b5.gif[/img]

[i]Note: Did you think the cushions were the only furniture you had to fight to secure your villainess' freedom?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png[/img]

Since March is a great month for tournaments, we’re excited to announce that we’re in the final bracket of our own tournament… and that you have the chance to cast a deciding vote!

A few weeks ago, we began the Save the Villainess Dream Lover tournament, which featured fierce fights between the love interests of our game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/36483be29c44d3ec00f8c422968b58abd7e5c949.png[/img]

Our characters have gone through seven rounds of fierce fighting, with each round accompanied by [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zgoylUglQ78eTcdLRXlGBjm1sUvoWXp_?usp=sharing]personal cards from the characters[/url] in both victory and defeat, as well as a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nY3U4swvlhQ&list=PL-woj8NObc6eLM-V6yQzYWJuaK_U3KLBC]special Youtube video playlist[/url]. 

Finally, we are at the finals, with Izel Kuzey (our Duke of the North) and Servant (the extremely normal servant) making their final appeals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/689c67412eca2849232833dbf4ddcdcf65a436ad.png[/img]

Will Izel’s passionate words about love sway you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/721079e59d58430739101c4ad5012ece87ef2952.png[/img]

Or has Servant’s success at… parties stolen your heart?

Cast your vote now and remember… the ultimate winner will be declared the fan favorite dream lover and will be featured in a special ‘video date’!

notes.title: Meet Raymond Alpin, the Man With a Plan!
notes.content:
Dear Villains and Villainesses, 

This is Tanya and Emily, your friendly developers of Save the Villainess. We hope you are having a fabulous end to your month… and we are excited to bring you a special Valentine's Day-themed update. We wanted to celebrate the season by programming one of our most gorgeous characters and talking about a plethora of romantic writing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e7a8cdf518f4c2aef0558db7b65d3408e434a204.png[/img]

This month, we finished the base programming for the amazing Raymond Alpin! Raymond is the royal cousin of Crown Prince Edmund Alpin, which means that Raymond is directly in line for the throne should Edmund pass away without any children. If Raymond has his way, that possibility might not end up being so distant either…

[previewyoutube=B-fZed3W76g;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, Raymond is a very… confident man. He’s convinced he’s the best potential ruler the kingdom of Carcosa has… as well as a good candidate for being the most arrogant man in Carcosa. 

Then again, is it arrogance if you really are that good?

So far, we have completed the base body programming on Raymond’s character model, which means we converted the Adobe Photoshop (aka PSD) file containing his art into hundreds of layers, the base of which we animated within the Ren’py engine using a combination of traditional animation, math, and coding. 

In future months, we will animate Raymond’s individual facial expressions so he can show off his joy, rage, sorrow, and even his sweetly blushing face. As we’ve mentioned previously, the complete sprite process can take upwards of one hundred hours. We look forward to showing you more of Raymond when this process finishes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/271e2df0163ddc6b47644fef43f5e3bc0b18303a.png[/img]

Save the Villainess is a choice-heavy game that puts our villainess’ romantic fate in your hands. You get to determine not only which lover she chooses… but if she should be with a lover at all! Thus, the game features several romantic routes you can go down… including 5 romantic happy endings with each of the love interests and 3 different single endings, as well as several different secret endings you must unlock for yourself. 

In honor of Valentine’s Day, we wanted to further enrich the romance in the game. Therefore, we revised all of the post-demo romantic choices in our common route. Now, when you choose affection raising and lowering choices, you will get longer dialogue skits and a deeper understanding of our love interests. The game will also remember these choices and use them to shape some later conversations in the game.

If you choose the affection raising choices, you’ll generally get sweet, affectionate moments that display more of the chemistry between Jane and her love interest that would make them work as a couple. If you are brave enough to choose the affection lowering choices, you may discover secrets about the characters’ lives that you might not otherwise discover until much later in the game.

Below is an example of an affection lowering choice that allows you to learn more about Izel, Duke of the North. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5c916891a422d3e2f578947dc3dd2ea7df157542.png[/img]

What choices will you make throughout the game? Play it for yourself and watch the mysteries unravel through your decisions…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png[/img]

This month, we had the great luck to be featured in two different Steam festivals that celebrate the power of storytelling and the creativity of women in gaming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e10cbf078eef50d65df0ccf4e6cff3bd77770ae4.png[/img]

First, we were featured in the Storyteller Festival run by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios]Two and a Half Studios[/url], the creators of Date with Death and the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3477910/The_Willowmist_Emporium_of_Antiques__Curiosities/]Willowmist Emporium of Antiques and Curiosities[/url]. This festival celebrates the magic of amazing storytelling in a wide variety of game genres. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/thestorytellersfestival2025]Check out the festival page here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b901fce2c842008d110744d4ff0c1028a0f3a647.png[/img]

Second, we are being featured in the Women’s Day Sale, which supports women-led games in a variety of ways. During this festival, we are streaming part of our demo with the amazing [url=https://otomeaddicted.carrd.co/]OtomeAddicted[/url] on our Steam page. Please see it on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578180/Save_the_Villainess_An_Otome_Isekai_Roleplaying_Game/]our Steam page[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2b64200bb4560c8507dc1e37f375c2213d50816f.png[/img]

We wanted to end by raving about Silent Kingdom, an amazing otome RPG!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/7f6d18d1dadd38a2057ba1d6c48755b89bf295d2.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828650/The_Silent_Kingdom/]Silent Kingdom[/url] is a dark, gorgeous, and beautiful game that has you play the role of Princess Erinys, whose kingdom has fallen under the yoke of a sorrowful curse. In order to save everything you have ever known and loved, you’ll have to stand against the entire world - and even defy the Goddess herself. 

Along the way, you will make many impactful decisions that will lead you to be loved or loathed, to slay or be slain, and to either save or damn your kingdom forever. The game also features a thrilling RPG battle system where you must work with your partners to overcome terrifying monsters. 

If you love dark fantasy, beautiful hand-drawn art, and thrilling battles, you will truly enjoy Silent Kingdom, which is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828650/The_Silent_Kingdom/]available in early access on Steam now[/url].

notes.title: Animating Young Jane, Celebrating Servant's Birthday, & The Elimination Game!
notes.content:
Dear Villains and Villainesses, 

This is Tanya and Emily, the two developers behind Save the Villainess. We’re here to wish you a Happy Lunar New Year – one that we hope is full of hope, joy, and growth for you! We’ll also share our monthly update about our game, including fantastic news on a major development for young Jane, a celebration of Servant's birthday, and a conclusion to last month's elimination game. We are starting 2025 off with a bang!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e7a8cdf518f4c2aef0558db7b65d3408e434a204.png[/img]

Our major news is that we’ve completed our initial programming of the teenage version of Jane Neville, the villainess of our game’s title! As you can see from the video below, young Jane’s face, hair, and body are now fully animated and ready to come to life in the flashbacks of our story.

[previewyoutube=18yvfINC_p4;full][/previewyoutube]

Every character model within our game is a custom work of art which can take 100+ hours to complete. Animating a single character model is a painstaking process that involves everything from the initial character creation to the creation of character parts to the animation of the character in the game engine. 

Even so, we love the process of animating each of our characters because we can give each of them their unique sense of life and personality. Thank you again for your support as we go on this journey with every single character in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/271e2df0163ddc6b47644fef43f5e3bc0b18303a.png[/img]

We also made great progress on our writing as well this month! We were fired up by the long but important process of animating teen Jane and thus, sat down with our master outline and wrote out two very important flashback scenes with her.

These scenes include some special guest stars that you’ll only learn about when you play the game itself. As you'll see when you witness the scenes, nothing about Jane is as it seems at first sight… and the interactions young Jane has with others may tell a different story than the one you think is unfolding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4fc6fd8cf12ede93426c4ce8296ff8af5c363b40.png[/img]

January also marks the amazing and enigmatic Servant's birthday – which technically took place on January 1st!

In honor of this special event, Jane, the villainess lead of Save the Villainess, is interviewing Servant. Hear them spill a few secrets about themselves and the world below.

[previewyoutube=rGsLK1laki8;full][/previewyoutube]

Do you feel the need to pry a few more secrets out of Servant? You’ll have to play the full game to learn more of what they are hiding….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png[/img]

Finally, we wanted to bring you a conclusion to the elimination game that started last month! Cloudy_floofs started the game, which gradually whittled down the 18 (yes, 18!) characters and/or creatures and/or unholy abominations that showed up in our demo to one remaining contestant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ce74668082c90ccb3e578a24ab34f714d01ac966.png[/img]

Behold Cloudy_Floof's masterpiece. 18 contestants come in from the demo... only who will win?

Every time one of the most important characters were eliminated, they even wrote a little card to express their feelings. You can preview the cards below or take a closer look at them in this [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1JrwwJdGDhSmVFaYjs6U9dH0oHTdnWO2k]google drive folder[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ac8b0109c43f1cfc61aa029e64a2fd0726a7ca91.png[/img]

MOST of the contestants lost gracefully! However, Horse may still hold a grudge...

A few people also expressed their strange distaste for Ben Buren, our game’s childhood friend. Of course, Ben had to respond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ff01778eb239f4d0801f9402febb8a02682005d4.png[/img]

Why is Ben so hated? That’s a secret still to be told… though maybe you’ll learn it during the course of our story.

Finally, after fans voted on all our social media, one person was left standing. So she's ready to thank you for keeping her safe!

[previewyoutube=bqbZpRn043c;full][/previewyoutube]

Friends, we thank you for spending another month with us and hope you have a wonderful year ahead of you. Please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:

[/list]
We hope you have a wonderful year ahead of you as well. Thanks for your support and take care until we talk again!

With Much Love,
Tanya & Emily
Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/9ca5d8ab8927dd8f694373b5742b0730d9854103.png[/img]

Dear Villains and Villainesses,

This is Tanya and Emily, the two devs behind Save the Villainess! We are thrilled to share our holiday update with you this month. We have so many treats up our sleeve… including an update on the development of Save the Villainess, a fun elimination game, and an interview and exclusive game sketches shared with the writers of Otome.com. 

[b]✦ GAME UPDATES!✦ [/b]

First, we wanted to share our game updates with you! Thanks to the generosity of our Kickstarter patrons, we were able to commission characters models of teenage Jane, Edmund, Izel, and Ben. Due to this, we have begun revising our existing game outlines and writing to incorporate flashbacks of our teenage cast. 

We have planned for flashbacks to teenage Jane interacting with the other cast members in the common route and in the three character specific-routes for Edmund, Izel, and Ben. We have outlined the character interactions that our teen cast will have with one another to expand on their relationships with one another, as well as to incorporate more information about the wicked, bleak, and blackly funny fantasy world they live in.  We can't wait to share more surprises and clues in those flashbacks. 

If you're nervous about who to trust, the flashbacks might help... or might make you even more nervous!

[b]✦ ELIMINATION GAME! ✦ [/b]

Now let's have some holiday fun! One of our amazing players - [url=https://www.instagram.com/cloudy_floofs/]cloudy_floofs[/url] - started a fun elimination game over on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/UcxdG55Zxr]discord server[/url] under the #stv-fanfic-fanart section. [b]✦ A NEW INTERVIEW! ✦ [/b]

We have something else to share as a holiday treat. Otome.com is an amazing website of passionate otome fans who review a wide range of otome games and do interviews with otome and dating sim game devs. A few weeks ago, [url=https://youtu.be/gGiTJfzuuwY?si=7iUjJMJFsxvnkAqK]they interviewed us on Save the Villainess[/url]... and we had a great time disclosing secrets we've never shared before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5c46303e29ac4b29f954ff61e7e3f0366113fa18.png[/img]

Thanks again to the awesome folks of Otome.com for holding this interview with us. If you want to hear more of our thoughts on the characters, inspirations, themes and behind-the-scenes-shenanigans of our game, please check the interviews out!

[b]✦ HAPPY HOLIDAYS! ✦ [/b]

As 2024 closes, we want to wish you a happy holiday season and a wonderful new year. Your support and kindness have made 2024 a magical year for us and we look forward to sharing more of Save the Villainess with you in the year to come.

notes.title: Save the Villainess Welcomes the Fall!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b1e307d3bc3d3959d4d051425ee9c15a398e6b76.png[/img]

Dear Villainesses and Villains,

This is Tanya and Emily, the two-person team behind Save the Villainess. We hope you are having a wonderful end to your summer and a cozy, comfortable start to your fall. We have some wonderful news to share with you as Save the Villainess leaps into its post-Kickstarter period.

First though, we want to thank you again for supporting us and our project. We have been working on Save the Villainess since 2022 and it is a true labor of love that came from our decades spent writing apart and our years spent writing together. 

Save the Villainess comes from our fascination with famous historical villainesses like Anne Boleyn and Marie Antoinette, whose tarnished reputations and tragic endings inspired us to write the story of a historical villainess who gets to triumph over her own enemies. Along the way, we enjoyed playing with many of the tropes of villainess isekai series and working with a mix of genres, including dark comedy, romance, mystery, and tragedy.

However, we could not create Save the Villainess if we did not have your support. Every time a player like you helped us by [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]joining our mailing list[/url], sending us an email at our contact @ bestlaidplans . net email address, wishlisting our game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578180/Save_the_Villainess_An_Otome_Isekai_Roleplaying_Game/]Steam[/url], leaving us a rating on [url=https://bestlaidplansproductions.itch.io/save-the-villainess]Itch.io[/url], joining our [url=https://discord.gg/w5tQZUFwAH]discord server[/url], and supporting us on Kickstarter… you have helped our tiny indie team immensely.

Thank you for making it possible for us to continue developing Save the Villainess. Without you, this game would not exist in the future!

We hope you will say in touch with us by coming onto our [url=https://discord.gg/w5tQZUFwAH]Discord server[/url] to chat with other players and with us (Tanya is there almost every night) and by getting the special monthly character cards from our [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]mailing list[/url]. Feel free to reach out to us via our email at contact @ bestlaidplans . net or through our [url=https://discord.gg/w5tQZUFwAH]discord server[/url]. We look forward to chatting with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/3ad701bdc81b30baef1791b1d45244c7152e723b.png[/img]

We had a very busy September! After finishing our successful Kickstarter campaign, we had to work through several post-Kickstarter logistical tasks. Thankfully, we have reached many important goals and are now ready to use Backerkit to deal with post-Kickstarter outreach.

If you are a Kickstarter backer, you will receive a survey from Backerkit sometime in October asking you to confirm your current order for Save the Villainess. You will also be able to order more digital goods from our online shop. Feel free to check our Kickstarter update post for more information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/d768fff42b17afea64b3394cb8c70ed80576a585.png[/img]

[b]Please note that we will not be taking late pledges.[/b] So if you did not join our Kickstarter campaign, you will not be receiving a Backerkit survey and cannot pre-purchase the game key or other digital goods. However, we will continue giving our mailing list supporters sneak peeks and monthly character cards. You can also purchase our game and merchandise on Steam and Itch-io when the game is released.

We look forward to sharing updates with you every month through our Steam page. We'll share some fun pieces of world-building, such as why Jane chants about being "serene" (it's tied to trends of the actual Victorian time period!), fashion trends that inspire the clothing our casts wear, and the inspirations behind the haunted manor that Jane is trapped in.

If you want more sneak-peeks into our game (such as more puns from Edmund, new survival strategies from Izel, lore on childhood experiences from Ben, and additional bits of morbid banter from Servant), please [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]join our mailing list[/url]. You can also request special monthly character cards from there as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/918e355db381989de7e9a342937bfba6f5324bf6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/776c7c6aa131c11479cfff479af7a533f0d96f9e.gif[/img]

We also want to share [url=https://www.otomelovers.com/l/save-the-villainess-demo-review-by-amjara/]a wonderful and comprehensive review of Save the Villainess' demo by Amjara[/url] of the amazing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/4680120-Otome-Lovers/]Otome Lovers curator group on Steam[/url]. This curator group is a collection of brilliant and insightful players who review a wide variety of games, including otome games (of course!), visual novels, hidden object games, simulation games, and more.

Please visit and subscribe to their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/4680120-Otome-Lovers/]curator group[/url] to find more great reviews about games on Steam. We have discovered so many hidden gems through them!

We also have added more videos on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E3zG1vX7KtA&list=PL-woj8NObc6eE72IRW8GdgwrUcIQT_bZO]Youtube playlist of Save the Villainess streams[/url]. Wonderful creators like Reaperbabe, Otome O'Clock, Liu-Fen Wang, Empress Rogue Red, Aerin K., Resting Peach Face, and Lilith Meia have uploaded their playthroughs. Please check them out and see the other amazing streams they have uploaded!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2b64200bb4560c8507dc1e37f375c2213d50816f.png[/img]

We want to end by showcasing some other amazing indie visual novels which have recently been released, are on Kickstarter, or are about to be released. Please consider supporting these games – they are all heart-felt and gorgeous works of art!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4e480f6133f62968403a7e8f83548b9a55701fa4.png[/img]

Obscura, a gorgeous and deliciously dark romantic fantasy visual novel, just released its second chapter for two of the love interests this month! This visual novel allows you to descend under a mountain to the marketplace below, where everything has a price. As a newcomer to the market, you will meet the four enticing masked men who can each give you what you need. But beware: they have their own hidden motives and uses for you…

Obscura’s Chapter 1 is free and contains hours of content to enjoy before you go onto Chapter 2. It is available on both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342920/OBSCURA/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://rottenraccoons.itch.io/obscura]Itch.io[/url] – plus, if you buy a copy on Itch.io, you will get a Steam key for free. If you love dark and mature fantasy stories, potentially deadly romances, and alluring men who hide secrets behind their masks, we urge you to give Obscura a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/0e09a6a6f11704656b69148de44c14ef457c53c9.png[/img]

If you enjoyed Save the Villainess, we also recommend trying Sigh of the Abyss – a beautiful dark romantic fantasy visual novel and roleplaying game. In this game, you play a woman with many secrets and shadowy surprises who can charm various allies, defy bitter foes, and fall in love with a gorgeous and inclusive cast of characters… or embrace the monster lurking within her. 

Your choices will save or condemn mortals, shaping the fate of a city as beautiful as it is cruel. If you enjoy a wonderful choice-driven narrative set in a gorgeous historical city with an inclusive cast of characters, please try Sigh of the Abyss. There is a free demo available on both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://rascaldevworks.itch.io/sigh-of-the-abyss]Itch.io[/url], and the full game will be released on October 11th. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4e85a1a15bcfa92f95bc40675c19b9890b7711fc.png[/img]

Interested in more in-development games on Kickstarter? If so, we recommend Lost in Limbo, a gorgeous dark romantic fantasy game that is currently on its last day of Kickstarter!

Lost in Limbo is a lush visual novel that challenges you to face the nightmares of your childhood and unveil the truth behind your summoning to the realm of Limbo. To survive, you must fight your way back home with the help of seven majestically beautiful but potentially dangerous deities who have sworn to be your protectors. Will love be the key to your freedom, or the first chapter of your downfall?

Lost in Limbo has a beautiful demo you can download and much more information on the game itself on their Kickstarter page. If you love lush, lore-rich romantasy stories, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ravenstargames/lost-in-limbo-a-17-dark-fantasy-romance-visual-novel]please check them out on Kickstarter[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/3ae0141ac5879fab77d23f81c4b7c1faa7ec0cf9.png[/img]

Finally, we wanted to share more about another great visual novel – Bitter Silver – that is a love letter to Cowboy Bebop and Telltale Games and that tells an intimate story with personal stakes for the main character, Lucia Lopez. Lucia is a queer, Afro-Latina woman desperate to find answers to a personal curse alongside her misfit crew, Zap Matters, her nonbinary, half-alien partner in crime (and love), and Hobbes, an aroace talking robot cat. 

You can get to know your crew through one-on-one conversations and ultimately define who Lucia is as a bounty hunter by the choices you make that will branch the story, from her background to how you take down bounties. If you’re interested in going on a thrilling, choice-driven, action-adventure with Lucia and her friends, you can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lookoutdrivegames/bitter-silver-a-cowboy-bebop-inspired-visual-novel]back Bitter Silver on Kickstarter today[/url]!

notes.title: Save the Villainess Heads Towards Third Stretch Goal & More on Jane!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/acadefe885c4e1affbf0e154fee55e1bf217936d.png[/img]

Dear Villainesses and Villains,

This is Tanya and Emily, the two-villainess-crew behind Save the Villainess! We are thrilled to update with the amazing news that as of today – 11 days into our Kickstarter funding campaign – we have reached our third stretch goal at $35,000 USD! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/7ba22a54b1a976392b7c6f22fa43d350e6e2b244.png[/img]

Thanks to your support, we will be able to incorporate new character sprite poses for our main cast members. The amazing artists at Somate Studio will give us new poseable character models that will allow us to stage even more dynamic investigative and romantic scenes.

We may even stage some tender scenes between her and her potential lovers as well, should you choose to romance them. Have you ever wanted to get closer to Edmund? You will be able to in the future!

Thank you again for your support, friends. Our funding campaign is a success due to your efforts. We truly appreciate your faith in us and hope you can help us reach our next stretch goal – more animated characters to befriend and menace Jane!

(You can never have enough animal friends… or enemies!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5ea1c8683f4149a80ef8dda6db4b90e0f97904e7.png[/img]

Recently, one player who went through the demo asked us: Is Jane [the main character of Save the Villainess] neurodivergent? Is that why she hyperfixates on minor details like the ominous cushions?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/fd3317aa5e490606b10cefc89b22885c7183c0ae.png[/img]

We wrote the reply below for our social media posts. We’re going to use this update to talk a bit more about Jane’s neurodivergence and why it matters to us – and to our players as well. 

[b]Tanya:[/b]

As an Asian-American woman growing up in the 90s, I always knew I was “different” from others around me. I could spend long periods of time staring into space and focusing on a rich fantasy world, even when I was supposed to be listening to school lectures or doing chores. 

However, I was already seen as “strange” because I was a first-generation Asian immigrant in a largely non-immigrant community… and I didn’t want to add to that difference by being the “weird spacey girl.” So I learned to mask and pretend I was “normal”... until I finally realized that I could only be my best self by embracing who I am instead of running from it!

[b]Emily:[/b] 

As a neurodivergent Canadian woman, it took me a long time to find a way to connect with other people when they thought and acted so differently from me. As I got older, I started to understand how many people similarly feel isolated or misunderstood because of the way they think and exist in the world. While I have written stories with more conventional characters, it has been a joy to write someone who truly sees the world in a different way and to explore how that has put her in a dangerous situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5ea1c8683f4149a80ef8dda6db4b90e0f97904e7.png[/img]

Ultimately, we both used our experiences as neurodivergent women to create Jane – a neurodivergent woman of color (like Tanya, Jane is part Asian). Through Jane, we want to show how neurodiverse people are affected by their unique and often unexpected ways of thinking and behaving. In the land of Carcosa, the fantasy kingdom where the story of Save the Villainess is set, many people can dismiss Jane as “weird” or “stupid” because they don’t understand how her mind works.

Yet ultimately, Jane’s unique mind and behaviors allow her to be a creative, passionate, intelligent person who can survive an incredibly difficult situation by thinking in ways no assassin can predict. 

Even when people mark her for humiliation and destruction, Jane finds a way to survive and thrive by tapping into her unique mind. 

We hope that if you have ever felt like an outsider or been mocked for your differences, you can see yourself in Jane as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5ea1c8683f4149a80ef8dda6db4b90e0f97904e7.png[/img]

As a fun extra, we recently created a [url=https://www.buzzfeed.com/fluffyfan42/if-you-became-a-villainess-who-would-be-your-love-4rlnq3alzw]free online quiz on who would become your lover if you became a villainess[/url] – starring none other than Save the Villainess’ quirky and (potentially) murderous characters! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/028ce1efcb79b55cf82f99752ee58b4139f89177.png[/img]

So if you love contemplating the futility of existence while staring at wainscoting or feeding little cakes to your date while you uplift your kingdom, [url=https://www.buzzfeed.com/fluffyfan42/if-you-became-a-villainess-who-would-be-your-love-4rlnq3alzw]take our quiz now and tell us who your lover is[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2b64200bb4560c8507dc1e37f375c2213d50816f.png[/img]

Finally, we wanted to congratulate our friends at Moira Myths for releasing the updated demo for their lore-rich and choice-driven fantasy visual novel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070170/The_Good_People_Na_Daoine_Maithe/]The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe)[/url]! Moira Myths led a successful Kickstarter campaign for The Good People last year. 

[previewyoutube=uUHw4Db4eBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The Good People is a rich fantasy epic that we love. We adore the protagonist – a brave and determined person who strives to go back home no matter what strange encounters they have with fae – and cannot wait to woo the beautiful and dangerous cast with them. We’ve got our eyes on Flannan – the handsome and stern king of the Unseelie Fae – in particular but the entire cast is amazing! 

We highly recommend their new demo, which promises a totally fresh game experience by featuring all-new backgrounds, a new UI, additional sprite art, voice acting, and more! If you love choice-drive fantasy games with well-thought-out lore and beautiful and suspicious characters, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070170/The_Good_People_Na_Daoine_Maithe/]please try their new demo now[/url]!

Hello fellow villains and villainesses! 

This is Tanya and Emily, the villainesses behind Save the Villainess! We thank you again for your interest and your support for our game.

We’re pleased that so many of our supporters are having fun with this adventure! If you want some additional servings of enjoyment, you can see playthroughs of the demo on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-woj8NObc6eE72IRW8GdgwrUcIQT_bZO]Youtube streams playlist for Save the Villainess[/url], as well as the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/save-the-villainess/clips?range=7d]Twitch archive of short clips[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/save-the-villainess/videos/all]full-sized stream videos of Save the Villainess[/url].

We’re still heading toward our third stretch goal of commissioning extra poses for our main characters! This will allow us to stage even more dynamic scenes between our characters, including additional investigative scenes and tender romantic scenes.

The brilliant [i]tinycandle[/i] asked if our Jane was inspired by Lady Jane Grey, the famous Nine Day Queen who only “ruled” England for nine days before being dethroned, convicted of treason, and beheaded. Our Jane’s name and plight is partially inspired by this doomed queen.

Jane’s last name, Neville, is derived from another historical villainess who also famously met a tragic end. Can you guess who inspired her last name?

Volontés is an otome game of magic and suspense where the main character, having lost everything in a great tragedy, must find her way in life. notes.title: Save the Villainess Hit 2nd Kickstarter Stretch Goal in 4 Days!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/acadefe885c4e1affbf0e154fee55e1bf217936d.png[/img]

Hello fellow villains and villainesses! 

This is Tanya and Emily - the villainesses behind Save the Villainess - once again. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/565568843/save-the-villainess-an-otome-isekai-roleplaying-game/description]We are so happy to share the news that we have reached our second Kickstarter goal at $30,000 USD thanks to your support![/url]

Due to your support, we will now be able to incorporate teenaged sprites of the main characters, Jane, Edmund, Izel, and Ben, into our game! You have seen the “adult” versions of all these characters in their twenties… but now we can showcase their younger selves in the game as well. 

We are especially excited to reach this stretch goal because this will allow us to create extended flashback scenes between a younger Lady Jane Neville (the original villainess) and the three men (Edmund, Izel, and Ben) that she suspects may be the fiancé who betrayed her. 

One of the main questions in Save the Villainess is: How did the original Lady Jane Neville become a ‘villainess’? Why were people so ready, even eager, to condemn her? What happened to her and what did she do to ‘deserve’ this title? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/641f80c92780f60ef82323677089dafbe476dfb6.gif[/img]

Another important question is what kind of relationship did Jane have with Edmund, Izel, and Ben when they were all younger? There are strong hints in the demo that Lady Jane Neville has known Edmund, Izel, and Ben for several years… so what were their relationships before she was condemned as a villainess? 

The current Jane is going to have to determine what really happened to Lady Jane Neville using clues and flashbacks she will eventually experience later in the game. The teenaged sprites we can incorporate with your support will help us stage dynamic, exciting flashbacks that will show you far more about Lady Jane Neville’s past… and give you a way to shape her future.

It will be so much fun… and heart-breaking at times as well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/c1204fe37183ba9365d8230d2f4315cae88568f3.png[/img]

With your support, we can hit our next stretch goal of more character models at different poses at $35,000 USD! With more character models, we can create even more dynamic cut-scenes showing Jane, Edmund, Izel, and Ben moving around the environment and solving… or creating problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/c6b0fd2ea0f90dac9d3573a19b5464e4cfcbf9e6.gif[/img]

These new character models will also allow us to showcase the characters in more intimate scenes that allow for extra passion and romance if you choose to go down romantic routes. We are so excited to hopefully get the chance to incorporate more of these models, thanks to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b09f27b7acd4587816b8368fd13c134e5fb53332.png[/img]

We also want to thank our amazing streamer friends for supporting our game and spending so many hours playing it!

In the last few days, Save the Villainess’ demo has been streamed by Deathblooms, Dream the 6-Eyed Wish Witch, Dee the Sphinx, Kumomo, Psycho Bunnie, EmpressRogueRed and friends, Iida Takimasu, Queen Bee, Moirin Strawberry, BoxCat, HusbandoGoddess, Suiyo, SamiDrop, Lilou Clary, and Ricebits.

Thank you so much to all of the streamers covering our game!  We truly appreciate all the hours of fun gameplay that they have shared. Please do go check their streams and VODs to see their reactions to Save the Villainess.

Fellow villainesses and villains, we hope that you will try our demo as well.
