notes.title: Save the Villainess: Surprises, an Upcoming Demo, and Kickstarter News!
notes.content:
Dear Villainesses and Villains:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/f63a06a8e59c06f388c635d4f8a50d152bc3e344.gif[/img]

This is Tanya and Emily, the devs of Save the Villainess – and we hope you’re staying safe in the scorching summer heat! In this newsletter, we'll tell you about our soon-to-arrive demo and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/565568843/save-the-villainess-an-otome-isekai-roleplaying-game]Kickstarter launch[/url], introduce a fun secret, and share some progress on our novel. We have great news coming up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e93513db8fde06797a931232e2ceaa474ea7193b.png[/img]

We are working through the process to release Save the Villainess' public demo and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/565568843/save-the-villainess-an-otome-isekai-roleplaying-game]Kickstarter campaign[/url] this July! Some of the timing will depend on approval processes beyond our control, but we are confident we will be able to share this with you soon. 

We originally planned to release our demo and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/565568843/save-the-villainess-an-otome-isekai-roleplaying-game]Kickstarter campaign[/url] this June… but we realized that in June, Steam hosts its annual Summer Sale and a giant NextFest for thousands of games. Instead of competing with these events, we spent June polishing up our demo and setting the stage for later parts of our game. We now have a demo that’s better than ever and hope you are excited for our projected late-July release!

Right now, we have worked through over [b]40 pages of notes[/b] for optimization and added bonus information. Emily has also revised and optimized all of our game’s beautiful characters, backgrounds, and cut-scenes so that the game runs as smoothly as possible while offering a fully animated and immersive world to explore. Thanks to our amazing beta testers, we now have a good idea of the minimum range of computer specs that can handle our game. We will use that information to help people determine what to use to play the demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/92a7147f73908d82a9b14a877dece2e7a927dddf.gif[/img]

Currently, [b]the prologue has 1,500 lines of code[/b]. Meanwhile, [b]Chapter 1 has 27,300 lines and Chapter 2 has 36,200 lines of code[/b] up to the end of the demo. We’ll be reusing some of this very important code (not including the code for things like the animated backgrounds and characters, which are in separate files) for the rest of our game, so creating stable code is really important!

We also have more secrets in our game than ever. Try out different foods at the start of the demo! See what happens if you replay tutorials… or skip them entirely! See if you can find all the new surprises we have hidden in the demo!

We will be submitting our demo build to Steam for review very soon after doing some testing. Once Steam approves our build – a process that can take a few weeks – we will be ready to showcase our final demo and Kickstarter campaign to the world. We will let you know when our demo & Kickstarter campaign release with a countdown on our mailing list and social media sites!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/8d5449702e7532d358775c0cf94756249401d1c1.png[/img]

While you wait for our final demo and Kickstarter campaign, we wanted to introduce a fun new secret – the first of many character portraits that will show up throughout our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/0da93f575b4e1c90036b2f69d0b1eb44911c8cc2.png[/img]

You see this lovely lady? This is Merlina and she is a portrait of someone we dearly love… one of our strongest and earliest supporters and champions. Her portrait was drawn by our amazing sprite artists at Somate Studio and comes to life within our game, complete with a few hidden secrets...

In our upcoming Kickstarter, you can secure your own animated, in-game portrait! Your portrait will be drawn by the master artists at Somate Studio and will be a major part of the plot in the final sections of the game. You too can share a stage with Jane and her suspicious love interests if you choose to support this tier of the Kickstarter!

Be sure to tune into our Kickstarter for more details on how you could purchase a portrait as well as plenty of other beautiful but limited prizes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/31fc740ce3b28a680582fae479ba0dd902c7f41f.png[/img]

We recently achieved two amazing new milestones. Firstly, our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoUsY4zYvoYea_TTtjkg6Yg]youtube channel[/url] achieved over 1,000 subscribers. Be sure to join us there for over one hundred unique Save the Villainess related videos!

Secondly, our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/565568843/save-the-villainess-an-otome-isekai-roleplaying-game]Kickstarter precampaign page[/url] achieved over 900 supporters!

Thank you for your help in reaching this amazing goal. Thanks to your generous help, we hope to reach even more supporters before we launch... After all, our project would not be possible without you and your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b83c8b22bbb7587995c1b0e87a6ccd77dfd21303.png[/img]

If you’re interested in delving into more villainess shenanigans, you can take a look into our developing novel, “The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/cf0c2214b6a886ec3d173e52a93494bede5b2186.png[/img]

You can find the novel on [url=https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/87587/the-villainess-wants-her-prince-to-live]Royal Roads[/url] and [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/56305633/chapters/143053204]Archive of Our Own[/url].

Recently, we got an amazing review from Ebert on Royal Roads:

[i]“I’m really liking this story so far. Initially started out with a classic villainess story premise; you know, visions of the future, arranged marriage to a prince, another “villainess” condemned at a party. Except, what’s this about deadly family dynamics? Why is the main character calling herself an in-bred shit in? Why does the prince (and currently presumed male lead) frolic so much? All the classic tropes of Villainess storylines, but with the humor and clever twists to revitalize one of my favorite types of stories.”[/i]

So if you want to read a story that takes every villainess story cliche you can think of and turns it on its head, try our novel today!

(Note: You don’t need to read the novel to enjoy or understand Save the Villainess – but you will learn a lot of fun lore about the world of Save the Villainess if you read it!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/03718239c50049e81e8bd70ef0fb6d412b4b5a18.png[/img]

May you all have an amazing (and not too searing) journey into summer. We cannot wait to release our demo & Kickstarter campaign and share so many surprises with you later this month. We just need Steam to give us permission now!

Finally, on our mailing list, we're also offering brand new character cards giving information about the what our main cast members would want to see in a portrait. Want those cards? [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Sign up for our mailing list today![/url]

notes.title: Save the Villainess is in Steam's Lovecraftian Days Festival!
notes.content:
Save the Villainess is now a part of[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/lovecraftiandays2024] Steam's Lovecraftian Days festival[/url]!

Lovecraftian horror is about the terror of the unknown, of what is just out of sight, just beyond reach. The enemy is often beyond human comprehension or understanding… or focused on a battle with your own mind. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/fef354d6374e475fff8fbfd5991c9d0031bdc6f9.gif[/img]

The creatures that do appear are alien and terrible beyond even what they physically show… the lurking shadows of dread.

In Save the Villainess, you will be coming to a perfectly normal House inhabited by perfectly normal… people with a perfectly normal set of experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2cd056e2f96acf1ea2ac9ed50d36878a3e466b50.gif[/img]

You need not fear the sounds you hear around you or the shifting of the wallpaper or the way everything is technically as the world should be but maybe not quite… [i]right[/i].

After all, you only have to do one small thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4b5f687630042f46d2d41751389a3e259f9c3e29.gif[/img]

To avoid what is hiding beneath the surface of this world, all you need to do is [i][b]Save the Villainess[/b][/i].

Simple enough, right?

Finally, we are planning to tie our public demo to some very exciting news we will share in April. We cannot wait to reveal more soon…

notes.title: Happy Valentine's Day & Beta Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Villainesses and Villains!

This is Tanya and Emily, the co-developers of Save the Villainess. We wanted to give you our monthly update - as well as important news about our beta demo test! 

We also want to remind you that our monthly company newsletter is going to go out on Thursday. It will contain Valentine’s treats such as a chance to vote on our game’s summary and the opportunity to receive a special Valentine’s Day present from your favorite Save the Villainess character. [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Please sign up to our mailing list for these goodies![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/702cc6d442ca98e1fe43e8a688dd4ed2c39041e1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/bb01734425b271942c11a4c1eed8b285e59a9084.png[/img]

Firstly, we want to update you on the results of our beta demo test, which we held at the end of January. We had an incredible number of people play the beta demo – sometimes multiple times – and then give us some amazing feedback.

We are delighted by the feedback we have received, especially from playtesters who were willing to play our demo multiple times to unlock so many secrets of our game. On our beta-tester-only discord, some of our amazing beta-testers even did let’s-plays of our demo and created a community-based google document to track clues and secrets from the demo and from marketing materials. [url=https://www.tumblr.com/dulcito-on-ao3/743251989258960896/dreaming-of-grass-haired-men]You can also read our beta-tester Dulcito’s lovely tumblr post about her experiences with our demo[/url]. 

We’re thrilled to know that our players are working hard to solve the mysteries of our game… though we promise that there are many more secrets, surprises, and mysteries to come.

(Our villainess promise is that all the major mysteries of the demo will be solved by the end of the game. Want to know why apples seem to be the only available food in our murderous manor… or how all of Jane’s would-be suitors found her so quickly… or even why a certain fellow in a top-hat seems to follow Jane around? All will be revealed in due time!) 

Ultimately, Save the Villainess is the story of one woman’s struggle to survive and smile in the face of dread and danger… and without your support, it would be impossible to tell this story in a fully animated world that contains dozens of secrets, mysteries, twists, and endings. Thanks to your help, we’re finding new ways to optimize our game and make it an unforgettable experience. 

Please keep following us for more information and fun surprises to come! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/38a0a57dc172a9215b225f15dd6ca2a036d506c5.png[/img]

We also wanted to take this time to wish you all a happy Valentine’s day - one complete with cards from all the characters of Save the Villainess. To see our characters’ video messages and cards, please take a look at this [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-woj8NObc6eFIVOe_S3TWra2nIy2PDZv ]Youtube video compilation[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/0222b03080fa37c95c9fa4ef56b00eb25d24bb18.png[/img]

[i][b]If you are on [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]our mailing list[/url], you will get the chance to request an extra special Valentine’s day message from your favorite character… so if you haven’t joined already, please do so today to [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]receive our monthly newsletter[/url] on Thursday, 2/29![/b][/i] All our potential murderers and one confused villainess are waiting to share their Valentine’s wishes with you!

Thanks again for your support, dear friends on Steam / Itch.io. We truly appreciate your help in making Save the Villainess a game that you can lose yourself – and perhaps even your villainess’ life! – in. We look forward to sharing more news with you next month!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/63746a59b64b630b68019ea810b05c40d4b6508c.gif[/img]

Hello fellow villainesses and villains! 

This is Tanya and Emily from Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc. We thank you for following the development of our upcoming otome isekai roleplaying game, Save the Villainess, and have an important announcement below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/bb01734425b271942c11a4c1eed8b285e59a9084.png[/img]

Friday, 1/26/24, is the final day that we are accepting testers for our game’s upcoming beta demo! So if you are interested in getting a special sneak peek of our game and shaping its future development, please sign up through our mailing list!

Once you sign up through our mailing list, you will get a confirmation email within 24 hours. Please check your spam folders or (if you are using gmail) your socials / promotions / other folders if you do not see the email. Confirm your subscription and you will receive an email shortly that will allow you to sign up for the beta demo.

The beta-demo process will be easy and simple. Once we confirm that you are a part of the beta test, we will send you an email in the week of 1/29/24 with a link to and password for a private Itch.io page containing the demo. You can then download the demo, play it (typical play-time is 3 to 5 hours), then fill out a short Google forms survey (10 - 15 minutes) asking you about your experiences on the demo.

Feel free to reach out to us at contact @ bestlaidplans . net (no spaces) if you need any help or have questions. We can always manually add you to the mailing list if you want us to.

Thanks again for your support! After all, if you don’t Save the Villainess, who will?
